summary: ST-05 is a non-empty story decomposing 3 parent criteria across 3 direct children, each carrying exactly one criterion verbatim with full union coverage: WI-05a (AC-end-mac, 1 behavior, 3 subsystems: MacGuffin in final-zone world data, retrieval rule, post-retrieval environment/creature/return-journey change, 2+ foreshadow links to WI-04b traces), WI-05b (AC-end-seq, 1 behavior, 3 subsystems: non-arena final descent with altered rules per sections 23/39, win-condition sim state, one-shot trigger, per-step reload survival), and WI-05c promoted to a nested story (id preserved, path stories/ST-WI-05c/) whose two leaves WI-05ca and WI-05cb each carry AC-end-variants verbatim, are 1 behavior with a strict subset of the parent's subsystems, and name WI-05ca final proof owner of the full fresh-save ending scenario. Requirements sections 23, 24, 25, 39, 45 and the section-70 ending checklist (one-shot trigger, final sequence works after save reload, credits/restart) are all covered, and spoiler rules (sections 0, 12, 68) keep the private mechanism referenced by id only in every leaf.
